blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Kylian Mbappé is only 19 years old.
exercises.why: After «девятнадцать» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This train is made up of seven cars.
exercises.why: After «семь» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Can you break a five dollar bill?
exercises.why: After «пять» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
After «шестьсот» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I only have a hundred rubles.
exercises.why: After «сто» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Just seven more days — then I'll see my sweetie again.

exercises.why: After «семь» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Set a timer for ten minutes.

exercises.q: Я заплатил за эту книгу восемьсот ___ (иена).

exercises.why: After «восемьсот» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Следующий поезд «Синкансэн» отходит ровно в девять ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The next Shinkansen train leaves at just nine o'clock.
exercises.why: After «девять» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: After «шесть» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
After «пять» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Во всём мире почти девятьсот ___ (миллион) человек недоедают.

exercises.why: After «девятьсот» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
